P6-GAP-001.current_behavior: Voiding sales and voiding expenses are hidden in UI for non-owners, but backend API routes do not attach Spatie permission middleware.
P6-GAP-001.required_integrity: Server-side permission enforcement on all destructive financial reversal endpoints.
P6-GAP-001.exploit_scenario: Cashier sends direct POST request to /api/v1/sales/{id}/cancel to void transaction without manager approval.
P6-GAP-001.impact: Privilege escalation and unauthorized financial transaction cancellation.

P6-GAP-002.current_behavior: Implicit route model binding queries records across all tenants before ResolveActiveBusiness middleware validates ownership.
P6-GAP-002.required_integrity: Tenant-scoped route model binding or explicit 404 on cross-tenant resource requests.
P6-GAP-002.exploit_scenario: Tenant A probes Customer ID belonging to Tenant B; endpoint returns 403 instead of 404, leaking ID existence.
P6-GAP-002.impact: Cross-tenant ID probing and resource leakage.

P6-GAP-003.current_behavior: POST /api/v1/sales accepts arbitrary branch_id in request payload without validating if cashier is assigned to that branch.
P6-GAP-003.required_integrity: Cashier user branch assignment must strictly match or constrain the transaction branch_id.
P6-GAP-003.exploit_scenario: Cashier at Branch 1 posts sale attributing inventory and cash drawer to Branch 2.
P6-GAP-003.impact: Branch stock discrepancy and cashier drawer variance.

P6-GAP-004.current_behavior: Sale store endpoint accepts client-calculated total_amount and discount rather than strictly recalculating from product unit prices.
P6-GAP-004.required_integrity: Server must compute line item subtotals, order discounts, and grand totals from authoritative catalog prices.
P6-GAP-004.exploit_scenario: Manipulated API payload submits PKR 1 total for PKR 10,000 product cart.
P6-GAP-004.impact: Financial loss via client pricing manipulation.

P6-GAP-005.current_behavior: Frontend enforces required mobile phone format, but backend FormRequest omits phone rule and drops field.
P6-GAP-005.required_integrity: Complete tri-layer validation consistency for user phone number.
P6-GAP-005.exploit_scenario: User registers expecting SMS OTP, but backend has no phone record.

P6-GAP-006.current_behavior: Purchase goods received confirmation executes within DB transaction but does not lock branch_inventory row before updating stock.
P6-GAP-006.required_integrity: Pessimistic lockForUpdate() on branch_inventory row during procurement stock addition.
P6-GAP-006.exploit_scenario: Concurrent POS checkout and Purchase GRN post on same SKU causes lost update on inventory count.
P6-GAP-006.impact: Physical stock count drift against ledger.

P6-GAP-007.current_behavior: Sale return refund endpoint lacks client request UUID deduplication or idempotency token check.
P6-GAP-007.required_integrity: Idempotency key or unique return transaction token on refund settlement endpoint.
P6-GAP-007.exploit_scenario: Network lag causes cashier to double-click "Settle Refund", posting duplicate cash ledger debit entries.
P6-GAP-007.impact: Duplicate cash disbursement recorded in cash ledger.

P6-GAP-008.current_behavior: Frontend triggers thermal receipt print before verifying successful HTTP 200/201 response from backend sale commit.
P6-GAP-008.required_integrity: Thermal print command must only dispatch upon verified server-side commit response.
P6-GAP-008.exploit_scenario: Database fails or rejects transaction due to stock limit; printer still issues physical receipt to customer.
P6-GAP-008.impact: Customer leaves with physical receipt for unposted sale.

P6-GAP-009.current_behavior: Purchase update endpoint does not verify whether supplier payments have already been posted against the purchase order before modifying line items.
P6-GAP-009.required_integrity: Server state machine must reject updates to purchase orders that have active payment allocations.
P6-GAP-009.exploit_scenario: User edits PO total amount down after supplier payment voucher is created, resulting in negative balance due discrepancy.

P6-GAP-010.current_behavior: Bulk sync ingest writes absolute balance snapshots from offline client instead of replaying nominal delta operations.
P6-GAP-010.required_integrity: Sync engine must apply atomic ledger delta adjustments (debit/credit) rather than absolute balance overwrites.
P6-GAP-010.exploit_scenario: Offline POS terminal syncs after 4 hours, overwriting payments collected online during that period.
P6-GAP-010.impact: Severe financial balance corruption on customer accounts.
